translationRepairs: Shizhi served Emperor Jing for over a year as chancellor of Huainan, still on account of the earlier offense.
Shizhi served Emperor Jing for over a year; he was made chancellor of Huainan, still on account of the earlier offense.
事景帝歲餘 and 為淮南相 are sequential clauses: Shizhi served Jing over a year, then was made Huainan chancellor; the original wrongly fuses the Jing tenure into the Huainan office.
In his bearing he resembled the old lords of Wei who won the people's love.
His forebears had enjoyed favor with the ancient lord of Wei.

The dossier reading 其行 is corrupt; standard Hanshu (and Shiji) has 其先有寵於古之衛君也—ancestral favor with the ancient Wei lord. The original invents resemblance and popular love; the repair restores the sense, and the next unit on ten generations of office supports the ancestral reading.
As grand minister of finance he let contractors use his clients as labor; the accounts fell deep into arrears.
As grand minister of agriculture he let contractors use his clients as labor; the accounts fell deep into arrears.
大司農 is the grand minister of agriculture; rendering it as finance mislabels the office. The proposed replacement matches the Chinese and the chapter's own literal.
His conduct had favor with the ancient lord of Wei.
His forebears had enjoyed favor with the ancient lord of Wei.
The corrected source reads 其先, 'his forebears,' not 其行, 'his conduct'; the literal field must follow the attested text.
